0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 7-2 and on a three-game winning streak, host the 4-5 Washington Wizards, who have lost two straight, in a game that is the Thunder's 10th of the season. The Thunder are 4-0 at home and sit 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West, while the Wizards are 8th in the East and 1.5 games behind in the Southeast. Out for Oklahoma City are Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, and Thomas Sorber, with Jaylin Williams listed as day-to-day with back spasms; for Washington, Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman, and Tristan Vukcevic are out, and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Thunder won 2-0, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21, 2026.
